body: Aion Instruct, Microsoft’s foundational language model for Windows, was unveiled by Satya Nadella at Microsoft Build 2026. I lead its post-training, now shipping on Windows devices.
Promoted to Senior Research Scientist at Microsoft, co-leading a group developing state-of-the-art Small Language Models, from pre-training to post-training and on-device deployment.
We launched Mu, our 0.3B micro-size language model, built for blazing-fast on-device inference.
Our paper “Learning to Reason Over Time: Timeline Self-Reflection for Improved Temporal Reasoning in Language Models” was accepted at ACL 2025 (Main).
Joined Microsoft as an AI Research Scientist in London, working on on-device LLM experiences for millions of users worldwide.
Our paper “HyperBERT” was accepted at EMNLP 2024.
Joined the Amazon Science (AGI) team as a Research Scientist Intern, working on test-time scaling for temporal reasoning with LLMs in Berlin.
Joined the reviewer committee for ICLR and ACL.
Our paper FLUID-LLM: Learning Computational Fluid Dynamics with Spatiotemporal-aware Large Language Models is now on arXiv.
Our paper TabMDA: Tabular Manifold Data Augmentation for Any Classifier using Transformers with In-context Subsetting was accepted at ICML 2024.
